title: Hide 'Test a rule change' until hosted steering exists
description: Fix now. 'Test a rule change' in PublicationCyclotronPanel calls an operation the hosted Cyclotron refuses; its hosted contract reports steering:false. Hide the control, or show 'not available yet', whenever the contract says steering is off, until M4. Read the capability from the contract; don't hard-code it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in #506 and #508 (released v5.19.1 via promotion #507). The panel reads features.steering from the Cyclotron contract; false or missing shows a disabled "Not available yet" control with a reason, true keeps today's behaviour. Test: scripts/test-publication-steering-capability.ts.
